card.name: Right before words about destroying or attacking
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "because" or a comma, and some word parts, where the next word is likely to mean destroy, kill, fight or attack. Seen in cancer-killing treatments and in war or sports attack descriptions.

modes.label: Treatment aims to destroy
